extension.summary: Functional: a clean, opinionated Kodi skin
extension.description: Functional. Built for clarity: gallery library views, configurable accent colour, slide-out filters, side-by-side library stats on home, and a tight video OSD.
extension.news: A Specials episode saved from the queue window with Save as List now keeps its season, so the Lists screen shows S00E01 under it rather than the show name alone. Import Lists no longer makes a second list whose name differs from one you already have only by case; such a list is skipped and a message says how many were. A lists file that already holds such a pair reads with the second one renamed, with a number in brackets, instead of dropped. Restoring a backup from JellyStat is refused when the backup names a list twice, ignoring case, and the list tied to Remove from Radarr is never copied onto more than one restored list. Setting Port by Time on the TV no longer makes JellyStat refuse its next change to the lists as made against an older version. The README and the install guide now describe the Lists page in Skin Settings and the JellyStat switch on it.

extension.summary: Install and update the Functional skin
extension.description: Points Kodi at the Functional skin releases on GitHub. Install this once and Kodi keeps the skin up to date on its own.
